title: Reunion with Bechet, Luis Russell band, California and Europe
summary: He meets Bechet in Paris, joins Luis Russell until 1940, then plays New York, California and moves to Europe in 1953.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Sidney Bechet. We came up together since we were kids in New Orleans. He was playing at the Shea Florence in Marmota. And it was a nice reunion, he and I, for a week or so. And I came back to New York, October 1928. Joined Larry Russell's band in 1929, beginning of the year. And stayed with that band until 1940. 1940. Which was a very pleasant experience and one of the best bands I've worked with. That was the band that we toured with Louis. It was supposed to be Louis Armstrong, but it was Louis Russell featuring Louis Armstrong during the 30s. I got out of the band in 1933 for about six months or so and played with Chick Webb at the Savoy. Came back with the band, with Louis Russell. And then left the band in 1940 and then I got tired of making these one-nighters. I played all over the street. Played with John Kirby's band. Took Buster Bailey's place for a few months. And played with all the small groups on 52nd Street. And went to California in 1946. Played with Ori for a while. And freelancing, I had the pleasure to play with Jack Teagarden and all the rest of the gang out there in California. And was house man at the hangover club on Bush and Powell in San Francisco for two years. And got enough of that sunshine out there and thought I'd like to come back east. Which I did. In April 1953. A couple of months later, I had an offer to go to France from Delaunay. Sidney Bechet spoke about me and recommended me to Delaunay. He corresponded for a while. In October 1953. I came to Europe. On a two months contract. To play with Reviata's band. At Club Padido. The two months passed so quick. And instead of coming back to America, I had offers to see the continent. And I took advantage of it. Went to Switzerland, tour, Germany, Austria, Italy, Spain. And it was 57 before I came back to America. Stayed seven years. And came back to the States. It was nice to see my old friends and relatives. In New York, Chicago, Los Angeles, San Francisco again. And after three months, I got homesick for Europe again. So I came on back and I'm over here. Very happy. Anything else? Yeah.
